title: China privately asks Iran to help rein in Houthis after Saudi appeal, sources say
description: China has privately asked Iran to use its influence over Yemen's Houthis to help contain the group's military campaign, according to three Iranian sources familiar with the matter . The request reportedly followed an appeal from Saudi Arabia to Beijing as Houthi forces rapidly expanded their control along Yemen's Red Sea coast. According to the sources, Riyadh sought China's help after the Houthi offensive increased the threat to Saudi oil exports and shipping. China has publicly called for restraint, dialogue and the restoration of safe navigation. title: US August housing starts 1.275m vs 1.309m expected
description: Prior was 1.239m Prior starts were -12.4% Building permits 1.394m vs 1.410m expected Prior permits 1.433m US housing starts fell 2.6% and permits were lower by 2.7% as the pain in the US housing market continues. US 30-year mortgage rates are now about 7% so there's no help coming but with the Fed showing that it's serious about inflation, there might be some relief on the other side of the Iran war, if we ever get there. This article was written by Adam Button at investinglive.com.

title: US initial jobless claims come in at 196K vs 208K estimate
description: US jobless claims for the week ending September 12: Initial jobless claims: 196K vs 208K expected. Prior 206K Four-week average of initial claims: 203.25K vs 206K previously Continuing claims: 1.730M vs 1.780M expected. Prior revised to 1.769M from 1.774M Four-week average of continuing claims: 1.761M vs 1.778M previously Insured unemployment rate: 1.1% vs 1.2% previously US initial jobless claims fell by 10,000 to 196,000, coming in comfortably below the 208,000 estimate. title: Asset Purchase Facility: Gilt Sales – Market Notice 17 September 2026
description: This Market Notice outlines the Bank Executive’s approach to implementing the Monetary Policy Committee’s (MPC) decision to unwind the gilts held for monetary policy purposes in the Asset Purchase Facility (APF). As part of this, Bank APF auctions will be paused while the Bank reviews a model of selling gilts to the Government.
